thread:
sara (customer-success): Quick alert — a few EU onboarding projects (notably NovaDesk) are showing stalled embedding indexing after last night's bulk backfill. Their demo is blocked. Need a short customer-friendly status + RCA + mitigation and a comp offer we can send ASAP.
amanda (cs lead): Yep. Can someone give a 3-5 line RCA + ETA we can paste? Keep it non-technical and empathetic. Include the compensation we should offer.
jon (eng): RCA (short): a recent scheduler tweak removed a safety throttle, which allowed too many concurrent reindex workers. One EU worker node saw transient disk pressure and retries compounded the load, causing elevated 5xxs and slowdowns for a small set of tenants. Immediate fix: paused the backfill, cleared the affected node, terminated retrying workers, and restarted a rate-limited backfill. We will reintroduce the throttle and add disk-pressure alerts.
mike (ops): Status/ETA: paused at 02:10 UTC, resumed under rate-limit at 04:30 UTC. Backfill running at ~30-40% throughput; projected completion for affected tenants ~14-20 hours. Ops can run a targeted expedited reindex for a single tenant (warm-path) and finish in ~1-2 hours if CS requests prioritization.
amanda (cs lead): Draft outbound to customers (brief):

"Hi <Customer name>,

Quick update from Redwood: during a scheduled embedding reindex last night a safety throttle was inadvertently removed, which triggered retries on an EU node and slowed indexing for a small number of onboarding projects (including yours). We paused the job, addressed the retry storm, and resumed a rate-limited backfill.

Status & ETA: the backfill is running and we expect your indexing to complete within ~14-20 hours. If you need demo-ready results sooner, reply and we can run an expedited targeted reindex (~1-2 hours) and will cover the cost for trial customers.

Compensation: we have applied one week of complimentary Dedicated credits to your account as an apology.

If you'd like a direct walkthrough or a prioritized run, reply to this message and we will coordinate a 1:1 office hour.

Thanks,
Amanda (Customer Success)"

sara (customer-success): Good. Jon — is "safety throttle" OK to include? Don't want to leak infra details.
jon (eng): That's sufficiently high-level and accurate.
amanda (cs lead): I'll send to NovaDesk + two other affected onboarders and cc sara + eng. Also note the optional expedited reindex. Will paste outbound here when sent.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0610 — EU embedding backfill overload. Severity: P3. https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0610
sara (customer-success): Please update the customer-health tracker: Impact=Indexing delay, ETA=14-20h, Credit=1 week Dedicated, Owner=amanda. If backfill exceeds 20h or new 5xx spikes appear, escalate to P2.
amanda (cs lead): Sent to NovaDesk + two onboarders and pasted the sent message in this thread. Will log any replies and escalate if they request expedited runs. :thumbsup
